item.description:
Improved • Actvt uses about half the CPU it did while an agent is writing to a long session. It no longer re-reads the whole transcript after every line the agent adds • With AI PII detection on, Actvt starts lighter: it no longer re-checks its 1.6 GB model from scratch at every launch
Fixed • With AI PII detection on, if the on-device model ever fails to run, Actvt now says so in the session's Sensitive Data card ("AI scan failed: names not masked") instead of quietly showing only the rule-based matches. A failed scan is no longer remembered as the session's result, so the next time you open the session it is scanned again. Sessions scanned by earlier versions are rescanned once • With AI PII detection on, Actvt no longer reports "insufficient disk space" for a model it has already downloaded • Actvt's window now keeps its size and position after you restart your Mac

New • Agent sessions now show memory: what a Claude Code agent knew, opened and saved in its memory during a session. The inspector counts them, the transcript marks the moment a memory was opened or saved, and Show memories lists each one with when it happened and what changed. Click any step to jump to it. For sessions on remote hosts, this needs actvt-cli 0.6.1
Improved • With semantic search on, Actvt no longer keeps up to two CPU cores busy while an agent is working. It now updates a session's search once the agent pauses, instead of after every line it writes • Actvt no longer refreshes its session list every 15 seconds when it was started in the background with no window open, as it does at login
Fixed • An agent running on a loop no longer shows up as gone quiet, or as waiting for your input, while it sleeps between runs. Actvt still tells you if it doesn't wake up when it said it would. For agents on remote hosts, this needs actvt-cli 0.6.1 • actvt-cli usage could crash on exit on Linux and print nothing. Re-run the install command on remote hosts to get actvt-cli 0.6.1 • actvt-cli usage can now read Claude plan usage on a host where Claude Code signs in with a setup token (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN), as headless agent hosts usually do. It reported "needs sign-in" there before

New • actvt-cli usage --json reports the Claude and Codex plan usage of the machine it runs on: session and weekly limits with their reset times, on Mac or Linux. Re-run the install command on remote hosts to get actvt-cli 0.6.0
Improved • Actvt uses about a third less CPU in the background. It no longer starts a process scan every 15 seconds to see which agents are running • With Actvt in the background, sessions show an agent starting or stopping within about 10 seconds
Fixed • The default horse icon in the menu bar showed extra legs. It runs on four again
